verdict.rationale: Choosing a storage region or data residency is a fair question for a hosted observability platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions region selection, residency controls, or deployment-location choice. Tiered storage (elastic-docs-35) concerns retention cost, not where data lives, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
